# CS Brewed

> Indie Apple software development studio by Serhii Chornonoh. Handcrafting native, focused, and privacy-first applications for iOS and macOS using Swift and SwiftUI.

- Website: https://csbrewed.com/
- Developer: Serhii Chornonoh (https://github.com/schornon)
- Philosophy: Private on-device data storage with secure personal iCloud backup, zero analytics or advertising trackers, lightweight native performance.

## Featured Applications

### Teeth — Dental Journal
- Platform: iOS 18.0 or later (iPhone)
- Website: https://teeth.csbrewed.com/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/teeth-dental-journal/id6753301026
- Category: Health & Medical / Personal Dental Health Journal
- Description: A private dental companion for iPhone. Keep an organized timeline of dental appointments, cleanings, procedures, affected tooth notes (using standard dental notation), and visit reminders. Private on-device storage with secure personal iCloud sync and zero third-party tracking.

### The Surf Hero
- Platform: macOS (Sonoma, Sequoia, and later)
- Price: $2.99 (one-time purchase, no subscriptions)
- Website: https://the-surf-hero.csbrewed.com/
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/the-surf-hero/id6738626783
- Category: Productivity & Utilities / Default Browser Switcher
- Description: A lightweight macOS menu bar utility to switch system default browsers in a couple of clicks or via keyboard shortcuts. Supports custom domain routing rules to open specific URLs in designated browsers.

### Perespiv — Sing, Parody & Guess
- Platform: iOS 17.0 or later (iPhone & iPad)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/perespiv/id6738500826
- Category: Party Game / Music & Reverse Singing
- Description: An interactive party game where players record short vocal segments of songs, reverse the audio, challenge friends to imitate the backward track, and guess the original song.
